title: Metrological traceability, decision-rule, and guard-band obligation tribunal
hypothesis: A typed tribunal can reject a synthetic GMUT measurement claim unless the measurand, calibration chain, uncertainty components, decision rule, guard band, and risk allocation are explicit and mutually consistent.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate measurand, unit, calibration parent, uncertainty component, coverage statement, guard-band direction, decision threshold, risk owner, and claim class; ambiguous, broken, under-budgeted, retrospective, or promoted rows must fail.
evidence_class: bounded structural or proxy software evidence
boundary: Acceptance is confined to the declared synthetic tribunal and does not promote empirical, participant, identity, authority, privacy, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
